A3.definition: A window is A3-positive iff both blinded auditors return NOT VISIBLE for every audited frame in every one of the 3 audit cameras. An UNSURE verdict anywhere prevents A3.
A3.interpretation: 3-view unobservability. An UPPER BOUND on physical absence and NEVER a certification of it: invisibility in 3 of the applicable cameras is implied by absence but does not imply it.

A_S.definition: An A3-positive window is A_S-positive iff every camera in the window's applicable set S_w (the D3 per-candidate applicable set adopted in revision 3; the symbol S_seq is retired -- it was defined only by the REJECTED D1 and D2) returns NOT VISIBLE from both auditors at at least 3 audited frames including the window midpoint and the last v == 0 frame. UNREPAIRED RESIDUE (round 2, B3): 'the last v == 0 frame' is undefined for a camera that never queried the identity (the documented 12.2% never-queried limb) and for a camera in which v is never 0, and it is driven by the very tracker flag M-2 showed carries no confidence information. That is a SUBSTANTIVE gap and is NOT repaired here.
A_S.grade: claim-grade ONLY with per-positive human confirmation
A_S.interpretation: full-applicable-camera unobservability, where the applicable set is D3 (revision 3): the cameras whose frustum contains the frozen candidate anchor. The permitted estimand is therefore, verbatim: 'unobservability across the cameras that the frozen candidate generator geometrically considered applicable, followed by same-identity reappearance.' This is NOT literal physical absence, NOT unobservability across an independently fixed rig-wide camera set, and NOT candidate-generator-independent event supply, and may not be described as any of those anywhere. Human confirmation validates the OPERATIONAL VISUAL LABEL only; it does not observe physical ground truth.

R_S.definition: An A_S-positive window is R_S-positive iff, in the post-window frames, the same identity reappears within r_site_census of its disappearance position under the sealed census return rule.
R_S.grade: claim-grade ONLY with per-positive human confirmation

blocking.B1_design_inconsistent_bound: Per-sequence Clopper-Pearson on (k_s, n_s) assumes equal within-sequence inclusion probabilities. The frozen B8 sample is a ROUND-ROBIN over (sequence x terminal class x pooled staleness tercile) strata, 3 rounds, without replacement, so stratum h contributes min(3, size_h) and equal inclusion needs equal stratum sizes, i.e. 3*N_s/n_s integral. PRIMARY-VERIFIED: it is NOT integral for scissor (68.600), poker (36.333), pour_tea (24.333), tea (4.333) or pan (8.250) -- and pour_tea and tea are two of the four decisive sequences. So k_s/n_s is not design-unbiased for p_s, U_s is not a 1-alpha/m upper confidence bound on the population count, and the 90% simultaneous coverage claim is unsupported. The design-consistent Horvitz-Thompson estimator is present in the file and deliberately given NO decision weight. Repair requires either proving per-sequence CP conservative under the actual design, or per-stratum bounds with U_s = sum_h N_sh*UB_sh and a larger Bonferroni divisor -- which MOVES the power analysis.
blocking.B2_bridged_frame_bias_absent: The same frozen B8 block discloses that audit frames are drawn uniformly over the CENSUS window, which INCLUDES bridged frames at which the identity is associated BY CONSTRUCTION of the flicker rule, so a bridged window can never be A3-positive whatever the scene contains (85 of 109 poker windows carry at least one). Deflated A3 -> deflated U_s -> kill EASIER, which is the wrongful-kill direction. PRIMARY-VERIFIED by grep: 'bridg' occurs ZERO times in this JSON and ZERO times in the prose page, and the B8 mandate to report bridged_sampled_frame was not carried forward. The human spot-check cannot catch it -- it is instrument geometry, not auditor behaviour.

MECHANICALLY REPAIRED in revision 4. The residue is NOT: 'the last v == 0 frame' is undefined for never-queried cameras and for cameras where v is never 0.
blocking.B4_recall_probe_has_no_construction_rule: '20 windows, DIAGNOSTIC ONLY' is the complete specification; no construction rule exists in this JSON, the prose page or the census prereg. material_not_repaired.M3_finite_population_magnitude: PRIMARY-VERIFIED. U_s routinely exceeds the logically attainable maximum k + (N_s - n_s): for tea at EVERY k (5.207 vs 4 at k=0), tambourine and put_candy from k=2, pour_tea from k=7. Capping U_s at k + (N-n) moves the kill from 2,580 to 3,141 of 7,000 -- a 21.7% shift in the decision region. The disclosed DIRECTION is correct (omission is conservative wrt killing); the MAGNITUDE was undisclosed and the power table is presented as exact. tea's published '6 of 9' threshold is unattainable in fact: 6 of 9 from N=13 permits at most 10 true positives, below the floor of 12.
material_not_repaired.M4_D3_direction_undisclosed: Two effects push A3 DOWN relative to any anchor-containing fixed set: S_w conditions on the candidate's own stale anchor (so the audited cameras are those with unobstructed geometry toward the last known position), and the triple MAXIMISES minimum pairwise separation (the hardest-to-be-invisible-in triple available). Lower A3 -> kill easier. Also |S_w| ranges 3-26, so the amount of maximisation varies per candidate and correlates with anchor geometry, making per-sequence UB_s non-comparable across sequences -- and the kill rule's 3-subset maximisation selects on exactly that. Bonferroni covers multiplicity, not this confounding. Bonferroni and the FPC each get a direction statement; D3 gets only a semantic one.
material_not_repaired.M5_undisclosed_supersession: The B8 block names prereg_m1_census_v1 audit_protocol rules as 'UNCHANGED and still binding', including camera_rule (the 3 TRAINING cameras of MAXIMAL PAIRWISE separation) and estimate (a one-sided LOWER Clopper-Pearson bound on the confirmed proportion). This preregistration silently changes all three: pool becomes S_w, 'maximal pairwise' becomes 'maximal MINIMUM pairwise', and the lower bound becomes a per-sequence UPPER bound.
material_not_repaired.M8_monotonicity_rows_never_sensitivity_t: A1 demotes on EITHER sensitivity crossing 0.5 'regardless of primary value', but readings (ii)/(iii) and BOTH sensitivities were computed only for the 4 measured sequences -- and 8 of the 10 E_select members are monotonicity rows. power_ANALYSED_BEFORE_EXECUTION.DECIDABILITY_IS_CONDITIONAL: STATE THIS WHEREVER STAGE 1 IS DESCRIBED. Stage 1 is NOT generally decisive. Its kill power exists ONLY because scissor and poker are excluded from E_select. With scissor, poker and pour_tea all admitted the kill cannot fire under ANY outcome. Stage 1's decidability is therefore CONDITIONAL on A1's coverage classification, which demoted those two sequences on a frozen sensitivity reading sitting 0.003 and 0.015 below a threshold. Any statement that stage 1 'can kill the route' without that clause is a misdescription of this design.
power_ANALYSED_BEFORE_EXECUTION.DEGENERACY_TRIPWIRE: if a future adjudication rule admits scissor, poker AND pour_tea to E_select simultaneously, the kill CANNOT FIRE under any outcome: at zero observed A3-positives those three alone give U = 93.7 + 45.0 + 30.1 = 168.8 >= 72 with each >= 12. Bonferroni is not the cause; the same holds at an uncorrected 90%.
power_ANALYSED_BEFORE_EXECUTION.E_select_of_10_result: DECIDABLE. Only 4 of the 10 have N_s >= 12 and can ever reach U_s >= 12 (pour_tea 73, tambourine 18, put_candy 18, tea 13). Over the 7,000 attainable outcome vectors the kill fires in 2,580 and does not in 4,420. CORRECTED in revision 4 (round 2, M1): revision 3 named {pour_tea 2, tambourine 1, put_candy 3, tea 0} as 'THE minimal surviving outcome', which reads as a necessary threshold. It is not unique and it is not necessary -- under the componentwise partial order there are SIX minimal surviving vectors (1,2,7,0), (1,3,5,0), (1,4,4,0), (2,0,3,6), (2,1,0,6), (2,1,3,0) in (pour_tea, tambourine, put_candy, tea). (1,2,7,0) survives with pour_tea = 1 and (2,1,0,6) survives with put_candy = 0. The named vector is ONE minimal surviving outcome, not the threshold.
power_ANALYSED_BEFORE_EXECUTION.consequence: admitting scissor turns stage 1 from a cheap screen into a near-census of that sequence. Any revision that admits scissor or poker MUST re-specify stage 1 before execution.
power_ANALYSED_BEFORE_EXECUTION.method: enumerate every attainable outcome vector over the sequences that can reach the per-sequence floor and ask whether the kill can both fire and not fire

n_s_required_to_remove_the_tripwire.note: CORRECTED in revision 2. Revision 1 tabulated these at m=11 while the U_s values one paragraph above are at m=12, which is the right basis (the tripwire scenario ADDS scissor and poker to the 10-member E_select, giving 12). The m=11 values were 132 / 41 / 27.

recomputed_revision_3.basis: recomputed independently by the primary at the reconciled m = 10 after the sequence-universe reconciliation and the D3 adoption, with Clopper-Pearson verified two ways (closed form 1 - (alpha/m)^(1/n) at k = 0, and bisection on the exact binomial CDF; agreement < 1e-12) and no scipy.
recomputed_revision_3.camera_rule_effect: NONE on the power arithmetic. D3 leaves 100% of the 73 windows with >= 3 applicable cameras, so no window is excluded on geometric admissibility and every N_s and n_s entering the power analysis is unchanged. Had D1 been adopted instead, E_select's stage-1 sample would have fallen from 49 windows to 14 and the analysis would have had to be redone.
recomputed_revision_3.note_pour_tea: WITHDRAWN in revision 4 (round 2, M2). Revision 3 said 'pour_tea reaches U_s >= 12 at zero observed A3-positives, so the decision turns entirely on tambourine, put_candy and tea'. The premise is right and the inference is FALSE: pour_tea's own count enters the >= 72 sum. (2,1,3,0) survives at 47.911 + 12.702 + 13.500 = 74.113, while (1,1,3,0) -- differing only in pour_tea -- gives 39.715 + 12.702 + 13.500 = 65.916 and FIRES the kill. The correct statement is that pour_tea occupies a subset slot unconditionally, not that its count is irrelevant.
recomputed_revision_3.unchanged: every published figure reproduces EXACTLY: kill fires in 2,580 of 7,000; per-sequence minimum A3-positives pour_tea 0 of 9, tambourine 1 of 6, put_candy 3 of 9, tea 6 of 9; minimal surviving outcome {pour_tea 2, tambourine 1, put_candy 3, tea 0}; tripwire U_s 93.72 / 44.97 / 30.12 summing to 168.805 at m = 12; the uncorrected-90% check 48.81 / 24.61 / 16.48 summing to 89.894; required n_s 135 / 42 / 27 at m = 12 and the superseded 132 / 41 / 27 at m = 11.

power_ANALYSED_BEFORE_EXECUTION.why: U_s = N_s * UB_s scales with the candidate count while UB_s is floored by the sample size, so a LARGER candidate population makes the kill harder, not easier

stage_1.purpose: a cheap validity screen plus a possible kill; never an admission. DECIDABILITY IS CONDITIONAL: stage 1 can fire the kill ONLY because scissor and poker are excluded from E_select; with them admitted no outcome can fire it.

human_spot_check.if_too_few_real_candidates_are_labelled_: record the shortfall as a diagnostic fact about auditor behaviour and report it; NEVER backfill the sample with decoys
human_spot_check.sample: 20 windows drawn ONLY from the 73 REAL CANDIDATE windows the auditors labelled VISIBLE. Presence decoys and recall probes are EXCLUDED from this sample.
human_spot_check.why_the_population_is_specified: revision 1 said only '20 windows the auditors labelled VISIBLE', which the fresh-context statistical review found could be satisfied entirely from decoys -- and decoys are engineered to be unambiguous, so a spot-check confined to them confirms only that an auditor can recognise an obviously present object. This is the ONLY gate capable of catching the failure direction that causes a WRONGFUL KILL (an auditor calling a genuinely-visible-but-occluded candidate NOT VISIBLE deflates A3, deflates every U_s, and pushes toward firing the kill), and that exact failure mode is already documented in the TRACKER instrument this audit exists to check.

validity_gates.inter_auditor_agreement_scope: candidate and recall-probe windows only; decoys HELD OUT of this statistic
validity_gates.on_failure: VOID. No route inference of any kind is permitted from a void stage 1, in either direction.

unsure_spot_check.gate: no numeric threshold is set, because none can be justified before the instrument has run once. A high rate is a VOID candidate, adjudicated by the user, not an automatic failure.
unsure_spot_check.rationale: an UNSURE anywhere prevents A3, so it has the SAME suppressive effect as a wrong NOT VISIBLE call, and no revision-1 gate sampled it. An auditor that defaults to UNSURE under uncertainty deflates A3 in the wrongful-kill direction invisibly.
unsure_spot_check.reported_as: diagnostic; the fraction a human judges should have been decidable
unsure_spot_check.sample: 10 candidate windows carrying an UNSURE verdict anywhere

stage_2.counts: exact per-sequence R_s from human-confirmed R_S-positives
stage_2.decision: the frozen cycle-2 selection inequality: there exists a 3-subset T of E_select with R_s >= 12 for every s in T and sum of R_s over T >= 72
stage_2.no_partial_credit: a model-auditor A_S or R_S positive that a human does not confirm is not counted, in either direction
pipeline_order: A_S pass on A3-positives: every camera in S_w (the D3 per-candidate applicable set adopted in revision 3; the symbol S_seq is retired -- it was defined only by the REJECTED D1 and D2) at >= 3 frames including the window midpoint and the last v == 0 frame (see the A_S definition's unrepaired residue)
return pass on A_S-positives: post-window frames, same identity reappearing within r_site_census
human confirmation of EVERY A_S-positive and EVERY R_S-positive
stage_2.population: ALL candidate windows of every sequence in E_select

tooling_boundary.permitted_now: build and test the frame-extraction and panel-assembly tooling on SYNTHETIC or DECOY-FREE inputs
tooling_boundary.prohibited_now: rendering, displaying, transmitting or storing any candidate window's imagery for auditor consumption
